resources.string: The delivery fee for each order comes from a rule written in JavaScript, in rules/delivery-fee.js. Edit that file in Code on the Go, save it, and tap Reload rule: the app uses the new rule without being rebuilt.
No rule file chosen yet. Tap Choose rule file and pick rules/delivery-fee.js in this project\'s folder.
There is no delivery-fee rule yet. Tap Choose rule file.
